assertions: Essex will take Reading — the town will be delivered to him and his army will obtain it
The town is obtained by surrender / delivery by its governor rather than by a long successful defence holding out until relieved
The governor of Reading is too weak to hold the town: Saturn, lord of the 4th for the governor, is in his fall
The King's side will not relieve or save Reading in time: the Sun, the King's significator, in the 7th in a fixed sign shows a fixed opposing party but no overcoming of Essex's significators
Essex gains honour from the enterprise: Mars, his significator, though in his fall is well fortified and in reception with the Moon, the Moon being in the 10th near Regulus and applying to Mars
The town's ammunition and provision, shown by the 5th house with its lord Jupiter and Venus placed therein, will not sustain a prolonged defence sufficient to defeat the siege
The delivery follows within the short timescale of the present siege — days to a few weeks, in April — once the Moon's application to Mars completes the matter, after a brief void-of-course delay
method: Classical horary astrology per Lilly, Christian Astrology — significators and essential dignity / reception / angularity as given in the chart judgment
reasoning: Ascendant Scorpio gives Mars for Essex: well fortified, mitigated in his fall by mutual reception with the Moon (Mars in her house, Moon in his terms and face), Moon angular in the 10th near Regulus (honour) and applying to Mars (sextile equivalent to a square in signs of long ascension), which perfects the matter for the querent's general. Against this, the town is Aquarius on the 4th and its governor is Saturn, lord of the 4th, in his fall — a defender without strength to hold. The Sun for the King in the 7th in a fixed sign shows stubborn opposition but sits in the adversary's house and does not overcome the Mars-Moon reception. Jupiter lord of the 5th and Venus therein for ammunition/provision do not outweigh the fallen 4th lord, so provisions cannot support a long hold-out. Moon void of course gives only a short delay before her application to Mars delivers the town.
summary: Essex will take Reading: the town will be delivered to him by its weakened governor.
